ayahs.2: Is kitaab (ke Allah ki kitaab hone) mein koi shak nahi, parhezgaron ko raah dikhane wali hai.
ayahs.3: Jo log ghaib par imaan laate hain aur namaz ko qaaim rakhte hain aur hamare diye hue (maal) mein se kharch karte hain.
ayahs.4: Aur jo log imaan laate hain us par jo aap ki taraf utaara gaya aur jo aap se pehle utaara gaya, aur woh aakhirat par bhi yaqeen rakhte hain.
ayahs.5: Yahi log apne Rabb ki taraf se hidayat par hain aur yahi log falaah aur najaat paane wale hain.
ayahs.6: Kaafiron ko aap ka darana, ya na darana baraabar hai, yeh log imaan na laayenge.
ayahs.7: Allah Taala ne un ke dilon par aur un ke kaanon par mohar kar di hai aur un ki aankhon par parda hai aur un ke liye bada azaab hai.
ayahs.8: Baaz log kehte hain ke hum Allah Taala par aur qayamat ke din par imaan rakhte hain, lekin dar-haqeeqat woh imaan wale nahi hain.
ayahs.9: Woh Allah Taala ko aur imaan walon ko dhoka dete hain, lekin dar-asl woh khud apne aap ko dhoka de rahe hain, magar samajhte nahi.
ayahs.10: Un ke dilon mein bimaari thi, Allah Taala ne unhe bimaari mein mazeed badha diya aur un ke jhoot ki wajah se un ke liye dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.11: Aur jab un se kaha jaata hai ke zameen mein fasaad na karo to jawaab dete hain ke hum to sirf islaah karne wale hain.
ayahs.12: Khabardaar ho! Yaqeenan yahi log fasaad karne wale hain, lekin sha'oor (samajh) nahi rakhte.
ayahs.13: Aur jab un se kaha jaata hai ke aur logon (yani sahaba) ki tarah tum bhi imaan lao to jawaab dete hain ke kya hum aisa imaan laayen jaisa bewaqoof laaye hain, khabardaar hojao! Yaqeenan yahi bewaqoof hain, lekin jaante nahi.
ayahs.14: Aur jab imaan walon se milte hain to kehte hain ke hum bhi imaan wale hain aur jab apne badon ke paas jaate hain to kehte hain ke hum to tumhare saath hain, hum to un se sirf mazaaq karte hain.
ayahs.15: Allah Taala bhi un se mazaaq karta hai aur unhe un ki sarkashi aur bahkaawe mein aur badha deta hai.
ayahs.16: Yeh woh log hain jinhon ne gumraahi ko hidayat ke badle mein khareed liya, pas na to un ki tijaarat ne un ko faaida pahunchaya aur na yeh hidayat wale hue.
ayahs.17: Un ki misaal us shakhs ki si hai jis ne aag jalaayi, pas aas paas ki cheezen roshni mein aayi hi thi ke Allah un ke noor ko le gaya aur unhe andheron mein chhod diya, jo nahi dekhte.
ayahs.18: Behre, goonge, andhe hain. Pas woh nahi lautte.
ayahs.19: Ya aasmaani barsaat ki tarah jis mein andheriyaan aur garaj aur bijli ho, maut se dar kar kadaake ki wajah se apni ungliyaan apne kaanon mein daal lete hain. Aur Allah Taala kaafiron ko ghairne wala hai.
ayahs.20: Qareeb hai ke bijli un ki aankhen uchak le jaaye, jab un ke liye roshni karti hai to us mein chalte phirte hain aur jab un par andhera karti hai to khade hojaate hain aur agar Allah Taala chaahe to un ke kaanon aur aankhon ko bekaar karde. Yaqeenan Allah Taala har cheez par qudrat rakhne wala hai.
ayahs.21: Aye logo! Apne us Rabb ki ibaadat karo jis ne tumhe aur tum se pehle ke logon ko paida kiya, yahi tumhara bachaao hai.
ayahs.22: Jis ne tumhare liye zameen ko farsh aur aasmaan ko chhat banaya aur aasmaan se paani utaar kar us se phal paida karke tumhe rozi di, khabardaar baa-wujood jaanne ke Allah ke shareek muqarrar na karo.
ayahs.23: Hum ne jo kuch apne bande par utaara hai us mein agar tumhe shak ho aur tum sachche ho to us jaisi ek surat to bana lao, tumhe ikhtiyaar hai ke Allah Taala ke siwa apne madadgaaron ko bhi bula lo.
ayahs.24: Pas agar tum ne na kiya aur tum hargiz nahi karsakte to (use sachcha maan kar) us aag se bacho jis ka indhan insaan aur patthar hain, jo kaafiron ke liye taiyaar ki gayi hai.
ayahs.25: Aur imaan walon aur nek amal karne walon ko un jannaton ki khushkhabriyaan do, jin ke neeche nahren beh rahi hain. Jab kabhi woh phalon ka rizq diye jaayenge aur hum-shakl laaye jaayenge to kahenge yeh wahi hai jo hum is se pehle diye gaye the aur un ke liye biwiyaan hain saaf suthri aur woh un jannaton mein hamesha rehne wale hain.
ayahs.26: Yaqeenan Allah Taala kisi misaal ke bayaan karne se nahi sharmaata, khwaah machchhar ki ho, ya us se bhi halki cheez ki. Imaan wale to use apne Rabb ki jaanib se saheeh samajhte hain aur kuffaar kehte hain ke is misaal se Allah ne kya muraad li hai? Us ke zariye beshtar ko gumraah karta hai aur aksar logon ko raah-e-raast par laata hai aur gumraah to sirf faasiqon ko hi karta hai.
ayahs.27: Jo log Allah Taala ke mazboot ahd ko tod dete hain aur Allah Taala ne jin cheezon ke jodne ka hukm diya hai, unhe kaatte aur zameen mein fasaad phailaate hain, yahi log nuqsaan uthaane wale hain.
ayahs.28: Tum Allah ke saath kaise kufr karte ho? Haalaanke tum murda the us ne tumhe zinda kiya, phir tumhe maar daalega, phir zinda karega, phir usi ki taraf lautaaye jaao ge.
ayahs.29: Woh Allah jis ne tumhare liye zameen ki tamaam cheezon ko paida kiya, phir aasmaan ki taraf qasd kiya aur un ko theek thaak saat aasmaan banaya aur woh har cheez ko jaanta hai.
ayahs.30: Aur jab tere Rabb ne farishton se kaha ke main zameen mein khaleefa banane wala hoon, to unhon ne kaha aise shakhs ko kyun paida karta hai jo zameen mein fasaad kare aur khoon bahaaye? Aur hum teri tasbeeh, hamd aur paakeezgi bayaan karne wale hain. Allah Taala ne farmaya, jo main jaanta hoon tum nahi jaante.
ayahs.31: Aur Allah Taala ne Aadam ko tamaam naam sikha kar un cheezon ko farishton ke saamne pesh kiya aur farmaya, agar tum sachche ho to un cheezon ke naam batao.
ayahs.32: Un sab ne kaha aye Allah! Teri zaat paak hai, hamein to sirf itna hi ilm hai jitna tune hamein sikha rakha hai, poore ilm-o-hikmat wala to tu hi hai.
ayahs.33: Allah Taala ne (Hazrat) Aadam (alaihis salaam) se farmaya tum un ke naam bata do. Jab unhon ne bata diye to farmaya ke kya main ne tumhe (pehle hi) na kaha tha ke zameen aur aasmaanon ka ghaib main hi jaanta hoon aur mere ilm mein hai jo tum zaahir kar rahe ho aur jo tum chhupaate the.
ayahs.34: Aur jab hum ne farishton se kaha ke Aadam ko sajda karo to Iblees ke siwa sab ne sajda kiya. Us ne inkaar kiya aur takabbur kiya aur woh kaafiron mein hogaya.
ayahs.35: Aur hum ne keh diya ke aye Aadam! Tum aur tumhari biwi jannat mein raho aur jahaan kahin se chaaho baa-firaaghat khaao piyo, lekin us darakht ke qareeb bhi na jaana warna zaalim hojaao ge.
ayahs.36: Lekin shaitaan ne un ko bahka kar wahaan se nikalwa hi diya aur hum ne keh diya ke utar jaao! Tum ek doosre ke dushman ho aur ek waqt muqarrar tak tumhare liye zameen mein thaharna aur faaida uthaana hai.
ayahs.37: Aadam (alaihis salaam) ne apne Rabb se chand baaten seekh lin aur Allah Taala ne un ki tauba qubool farmaayi, beshak wahi tauba qubool karne wala aur reham karne wala hai.
ayahs.38: Hum ne kaha tum sab yahaan se chale jaao, jab kabhi tumhare paas meri hidayat pahunche to us ki taabedaari karne walon par koi khauf-o-gham nahi.
ayahs.39: Aur jo inkaar karke hamari aayaton ko jhutlaayen, woh jahannami hain aur hamesha usi mein rahenge.
ayahs.40: Aye Bani Israeel! Meri us ne'mat ko yaad karo jo main ne tum par in'aam ki aur mere ahd ko poora karo main tumhare ahd ko poora karoonga aur mujh hi se daro.
ayahs.41: Aur us kitaab par imaan lao jo main ne tumhari kitaabon ki tasdeeq mein naazil farmaayi hai aur us ke saath tum hi pehle kaafir na bano aur meri aayaton ko thodi thodi qeemat par na farokht karo aur sirf mujh hi se daro.
ayahs.42: Aur haq ko baatil ke saath khalt-malt na karo aur na haq ko chhupaao, tumhe to khud us ka ilm hai.
ayahs.43: Aur namazon ko qaaim karo aur zakaat do aur ruku karne walon ke saath ruku karo.
ayahs.44: Kya logon ko bhalaaiyon ka hukm karte ho? Aur khud apne aap ko bhool jaate ho baa-wujoodyeke tum kitaab padhte ho, kya itni bhi tum mein samajh nahi?
ayahs.45: Aur sabr aur namaz ke saath madad talab karo, yeh cheez shaaq hai, magar dar rakhne walon par (nahi).
ayahs.46: Jo jaante hain ke beshak woh apne Rabb se mulaaqaat karne wale aur yaqeenan woh usi ki taraf laut kar jaane wale hain.
ayahs.47: Aye aulaad-e-Yaqoob! Meri us ne'mat ko yaad karo jo main ne tum par in'aam ki aur main ne tumhe tamaam jahaanon par fazeelat di.
ayahs.48: Us din se darte raho jab koi kisi ko nafa na de sakega aur na hi us ki baabat koi sifaarish qubool hogi aur na koi badla us ke ewaz liya jaayega aur na woh madad kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.49: Aur jab hum ne tumhe firauniyon se najaat di jo tumhe badtareen azaab dete the, jo tumhare ladkon ko maar daalte the aur tumhari ladkiyon ko chhod dete the, us najaat dene mein tumhare Rabb ki badi meharbaani thi.
ayahs.50: Aur jab hum ne tumhare liye darya cheer (phaad) diya aur tumhe us se paar kardiya aur firauniyon ko tumhari nazron ke saamne us mein dubo diya.
ayahs.51: Aur hum ne (Hazrat) Moosa (alaihis salaam) se chaalees raaton ka waada kiya, phir tum ne us ke baad bachhda poojna shuroo kardiya aur zaalim ban gaye.
ayahs.52: Lekin hum ne baa-wujood us ke phir bhi tumhe maaf kardiya, taake tum shukr karo.
ayahs.53: Aur hum ne (Hazrat) Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko tumhari hidayat ke liye kitaab aur mojze ata farmaaye.
ayahs.54: Jab (Hazrat Moosa) (alaihis salaam) ne apni qaum se kaha ke aye meri qaum! Bachhde ko mabood bana kar tum ne apni jaanon par zulm kiya hai, ab tum apne paida karne wale ki taraf rujoo karo, apne ko aapas mein qatl karo, tumhari behtari Allah Taala ke nazdeek isi mein hai, to us ne tumhari tauba qubool ki, woh tauba qubool karne wala aur reham-o-karam karne wala hai.
ayahs.55: Aur (tum use bhi yaad karo) tum ne (Hazrat) Moosa (alaihis salaam) se kaha tha ke jab tak hum apne Rabb ko saamne na dekh len hargiz imaan na laayenge (jis gustaakhi ki saza mein) tum par tumhare dekhte hue bijli giri.
ayahs.56: Lekin phir is liye ke tum shukrguzaari karo, us maut ke baad bhi hum ne tumhe zinda kardiya.
ayahs.57: Aur hum ne tum par baadal ka saaya kiya aur tum par mann-o-salwa utaara (aur keh diya) ke hamari di hui paakeeza cheezen khaao, aur unhon ne hum par zulm nahi kiya, albatta woh khud apni jaanon par zulm karte the.
ayahs.58: Aur hum ne tum se kaha ke us basti mein jaao aur jo kuch jahaan kahin se chaaho baa-firaaghat khaao piyo aur darwaaze mein sajde karte hue guzro aur zabaan se 'hitta' kaho, hum tumhari khataayen maaf farmaadenge aur neki karne walon ko aur ziyaada denge.
ayahs.59: Phir un zaalimon ne us baat ko jo un se kahi gayi thi badal daali, hum ne bhi un zaalimon par un ke fisq-o-naafarmaani ki wajah se aasmaani azaab naazil kiya.
ayahs.60: Aur jab Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apni qaum ke liye paani maanga to hum ne kaha ke apni laathi patthar par maaro, jis se baarah chashme phoot nikle aur har grooh ne apna chashma pehchaan liya (aur hum ne keh diya ke) Allah Taala ka rizq khaao piyo aur zameen mein fasaad na karte phiro.
ayahs.61: Aur jab tum ne kaha aye Moosa! Hum se ek hi qism ke khaane par hargiz sabr na hosakega, is liye apne Rabb se dua kijiye ke woh hamein zameen ki paidaawaar saag, kakdi, gehoon, masoor aur piyaaz de. Aap ne farmaya, behtar cheez ke badle adna cheez kyun talab karte ho! Achha shehar mein jaao wahaan tumhari chaahat ki yeh sab cheezen milengi. Un par zillat aur miskeeni daal di gayi aur Allah Taala ka ghazab le kar woh laute, yeh is liye ke woh Allah Taala ki aayaton ke saath kufr karte the aur nabiyon ko naahaq qatl karte the, yeh un ki naafarmaaniyon aur ziyaadatiyon ka nateeja hai.
ayahs.62: Musalmaan hon, yahoodi hon, nasaara hon ya saabi hon, jo koi bhi Allah Taala par aur qayamat ke din par imaan laaye aur nek amal kare un ke ajr un ke Rabb ke paas hain aur un par na to koi khauf hai aur na udaasi.
ayahs.63: Aur jab hum ne tum se waada liya aur tum par Toor pahaad laa khada kardiya (aur kaha) jo hum ne tumhe diya hai, use mazbooti se thaam lo aur jo kuch us mein hai use yaad karo taake tum bach sako.
ayahs.64: Lekin tum us ke baad bhi phir gaye, phir agar Allah Taala ka fazl aur us ki rehmat tum par na hoti to tum nuqsaan wale hojaate.
ayahs.65: Aur yaqeenan tumhe un logon ka ilm bhi hai jo tum mein se hafte ke baare mein hadd se badh gaye aur hum ne bhi keh diya ke tum zaleel bandar ban jaao.
ayahs.66: Use hum ne aglon pichhlon ke liye ibrat ka sabab bana diya aur parhezgaron ke liye waz-o-naseehat ka.
ayahs.67: Aur (Hazrat) Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne jab apni qaum se kaha ke Allah Taala tumhe ek gaaye zibah karne ka hukm deta hai to unhon ne kaha hum se mazaaq kyun karte hain? Aap ne jawaab diya ke main aisa jaahil hone se Allah Taala ki panaah pakadta hoon.
ayahs.68: Unhon ne kaha aye Moosa! Dua kijiye ke Allah Taala hamare liye us ki maahiyat bayaan karde, aap ne farmaya suno! Woh gaaye na to bilkul budhiya ho, na bachcha, balke darmiyaani umr ki naujawaan ho, ab jo tumhe hukm diya gaya hai baja lao.
ayahs.69: Woh phir kehne lage ke dua kijiye ke Allah Taala bayaan kare ke us ka rang kya hai? Farmaya woh kehta hai ke woh gaaye zard rang ki hai, chamkeela aur dekhne walon ko bhala lagne wala us ka rang hai.
ayahs.70: Woh kehne lage ke apne Rabb se aur dua kijiye ke hamein us ki mazeed maahiyat batlaaye, is qism ki gaaye to bahut hain pata nahi chalta, agar Allah ne chaaha to hum hidayat wale hojaayenge.
ayahs.71: Aap ne farmaya ke Allah ka farmaan hai ke woh gaaye kaam karne wali, zameen mein hal jotne wali aur kheton ko paani pilaane wali nahi, woh tandurust aur be-daagh hai. Unhon ne kaha, ab aap ne haq waazeh kardiya, go woh hukm-bardaari ke qareeb na the, lekin use maana aur woh gaaye zibah kardi.
ayahs.72: Jab tum ne ek shakhs ko qatl kar daala, phir us mein ikhtilaaf karne lage aur tumhari posheedgi ko Allah Taala zaahir karne wala tha.
ayahs.73: Hum ne kaha ke us gaaye ka ek tukda maqtool ke jism par laga do, (woh ji uthega) isi tarah Allah murdon ko zinda karke tumhe tumhari aqlmandi ke liye apni nishaaniyaan dikhaata hai.
ayahs.74: Phir us ke baad tumhare dil patthar jaise balke us se bhi ziyaada sakht hogaye, baaz pattharon se to nahren beh nikalti hain, aur baaz phat jaate hain aur un se paani nikal aata hai, aur baaz Allah Taala ke dar se gir gir padte hain, aur tum Allah Taala ko apne aamaal se ghaafil na jaano.
ayahs.75: (Musalmaano!) Kya tumhari khwaahish hai ke yeh log imaandaar ban jaayen, haalaanke un mein aise log bhi jo kalaam-e-Allah ko sun kar, aql-o-ilm wale hote hue, phir bhi badal daala karte hain.
ayahs.76: Jab imaan walon se milte hain to apni imaandaari zaahir karte hain aur jab aapas mein milte hain to kehte hain ke musalmaanon ko kyun woh baaten pahunchaate ho jo Allah Taala ne tumhe sikhaayi hain, kya jaante nahi ke yeh to Allah Taala ke paas tum par un ki hujjat hojaayegi.
ayahs.77: Kya yeh nahi jaante ke Allah Taala un ki posheedgi aur zaahirdaari sab ko jaanta hai?
ayahs.78: Un mein se baaz an-padh aise bhi hain ke jo kitaab ke sirf zaahiri alfaaz ko hi jaante hain aur sirf gumaan aur atkal hi par hain.
ayahs.79: Un logon ke liye 'wail' hai jo apne haathon ki likhi hui kitaab ko Allah Taala ki taraf ki kehte hain aur is tarah dunya kamaate hain, un ke haathon ki likhaayi ko aur un ki kamaayi ko wail (halaakat) aur afsos hai.
ayahs.80: Yeh log kehte hain ke hum to sirf chand roz jahannam mein rahenge, un se kaho ke kya tumhare paas Allah Taala ka koi parwaana hai? Agar hai to yaqeenan Allah Taala apne waade ka khilaaf nahi karega, (hargiz nahi) balke tum to Allah ke zimme woh baaten lagaate ho jinhe tum nahi jaante.
ayahs.81: Yaqeenan jis ne bhi bure kaam kiye aur us ki naafarmaaniyon ne use gher liya, woh hamesha ke liye jahannami hai.
ayahs.82: Aur jo log imaan laayen aur nek kaam karen woh jannati hain jo jannat mein hamesha rahenge.
ayahs.83: Aur jab hum ne Bani Israeel se waada liya ke tum Allah Taala ke siwa doosre ki ibaadat na karna aur maa baap ke saath achha sulook karna, isi tarah qaraabatdaaron, yateemon aur miskeenon ke saath aur logon ko achhi baaten kehna, namazen qaaim rakhna aur zakaat dete raha karna, lekin thode se logon ke ilaawa tum sab phir gaye aur munh mod liya.
ayahs.84: Aur jab hum ne tum se waada liya ke aapas mein khoon na bahaana (qatl na karna) aur aapas waalon ko jila-watan na karna, tum ne iqraar kiya aur tum us ke shaahid bane.
ayahs.85: Lekin phir bhi tum ne aapas mein qatl kiya aur aapas ke ek firqe ko jila-watan bhi kiya aur gunaah aur ziyaadati ke kaamon mein un ke khilaaf doosre ki tarafdaari ki, haan jab woh qaidi ho kar tumhare paas aaye to tum ne un ke fidye diye, lekin un ka nikaalna jo tum par haraam tha (us ka kuch khayaal na kiya) kya baaz ahkaam par imaan rakhte ho aur baaz ke saath kufr karte ho? Tum mein se jo bhi aisa kare, us ki saza us ke siwa kya ho ke dunya mein ruswaayi aur qayamat ke din sakht azaab ki maar, aur Allah Taala tumhare aamaal se be-khabar nahi.
ayahs.86: Yeh woh log hain jinhon ne dunya ki zindagi ko aakhirat ke badle khareed liya hai, un ke na to azaab halke honge aur na un ki madad ki jaayegi.
ayahs.87: Hum ne (Hazrat) Moosa ko kitaab di aur un ke peechhe aur Rasool bheje aur hum ne (Hazrat) Eesa ibn-e-Maryam ko roshan daleelen din aur Rooh-ul-Qudus se un ki taayeed karwaayi. Lekin jab kabhi tumhare paas Rasool woh cheez laaye jo tumhari tabeeaton ke khilaaf thi, tum ne jhat se takabbur kiya, pas baaz ko to jhutla diya aur baaz ko qatl bhi kar daala.
ayahs.88: Yeh kehte hain ke hamare dil ghilaaf wale hain, nahi nahi balke un ke kufr ki wajah se unhe Allah Taala ne mal'oon kardiya hai, un ka imaan bahut hi thoda hai.
ayahs.89: Aur un ke paas jab Allah Taala ki kitaab un ki kitaab ko sachcha karne wali aayi, haalaanke pehle yeh khud (us ke zariye) kaafiron par fatah chaahte the to baa-wujood aa jaane aur baa-wujood pehchaan lene ke phir kufr karne lage, Allah Taala ki laanat ho kaafiron par.
ayahs.90: Bahut buri hai woh cheez jis ke badle unhon ne apne aap ko bech daala, woh un ka kufr karna hai. Allah Taala ki taraf se naazil-shuda cheez ke saath mahaz is baat se jal kar ke Allah Taala ne apna fazl apne jis bande par chaaha naazil farmaya, us ke baa'is yeh log ghazab par ghazab ke mustahiq hogaye aur un kaafiron ke liye ruswa karne wala azaab hai.
ayahs.91: Aur jab un se kaha jaata hai ke Allah Taala ki utaari hui kitaab par imaan lao to keh dete hain ke jo hum par utaari gayi us par hamara imaan hai. Haalaanke us ke baad wali ke saath jo un ki kitaab ki tasdeeq karne wali hai, kufr karte hain, achha un se yeh to daryaaft karen ke agar tumhara imaan pehli kitaabon par hai to phir tum ne agle ambiya ko kyun qatl kiya?
ayahs.92: Tumhare paas to Moosa yahi daleelen le kar aaye lekin tum ne phir bhi bachhda pooja, tum ho hi zaalim.
ayahs.93: Jab hum ne tum se waada liya aur tum par Toor ko khada kardiya (aur keh diya) ke hamari di hui cheez ko mazboot thaamo aur suno! To unhon ne kaha, hum ne suna aur naafarmaani ki aur un ke dilon mein bachhde ki muhabbat (goya) pila di gayi ba-sabab un ke kufr ke. Un se keh dijiye ke tumhara imaan tumhe bura hukm de raha hai, agar tum momin ho.
ayahs.94: Aap keh dijiye ke agar aakhirat ka ghar sirf tumhare hi liye hai, Allah ke nazdeek aur kisi ke liye nahi, to aao apni sachaayi ke saboot mein maut talab karo.
ayahs.95: Lekin apni kartooton ko dekhte hue kabhi bhi maut nahi maangenge, Allah Taala zaalimon ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.96: Balke sab se ziyaada dunya ki zindagi ka harees aye Nabi! Aap inhi ko paayenge. Yeh hirs-e-zindagi mein mushrikon se bhi ziyaada hain, un mein se to har shakhs ek ek hazaar saal ki umr chaahta hai, goya yeh umr diya jaana bhi unhe azaab se nahi chhuda sakta, Allah Taala un ke kaamon ko bakhoobi dekh raha hai.
ayahs.97: (Aye Nabi!) Aap keh dijiye: jo shakhs Jibreel ka dushman hai, to beshak us ne is (Qur'an) ko aap ke dil par Allah ke hukm se utaara hai, jo apne se pehle ki kitaab ki tasdeeq karne wala aur mominon ko hidayat aur khushkhabri dene wala hai (to Allah bhi us ka dushman hai).
ayahs.98: Jo shakhs Allah ka aur us ke farishton aur us ke Rasoolon aur Jibraeel aur Mikaeel ka dushman ho, aise kaafiron ka dushman khud Allah hai.
ayahs.99: Aur yaqeenan hum ne aap ki taraf roshan daleelen bheji hain jin ka inkaar siwaaye badkaaron ke koi nahi karta.
ayahs.100: Yeh log jab kabhi koi ahd karte hain to un ki ek na ek jamaat use tod deti hai, balke un mein se aksar imaan se khaali hain.
ayahs.101: Jab kabhi un ke paas Allah ka koi Rasool un ki kitaab ki tasdeeq karne wala aaya, un ahl-e-kitaab ke ek firqe ne Allah ki kitaab ko is tarah peeth peechhe daal diya, goya jaante hi na the.
ayahs.102: Aur us cheez ke peechhe lag gaye jise shayaateen (Hazrat) Sulaiman ki hukoomat mein padhte the. Sulaiman ne to kufr na kiya tha, balke yeh kufr shaitaanon ka tha, woh logon ko jaadu sikhaaya karte the, aur Baabil mein Haaroot Maaroot do farishton par jo utaara gaya tha, woh dono bhi kisi shakhs ko us waqt tak nahi sikhaate the jab tak yeh na keh den ke hum to ek aazmaaish hain to kufr na kar, phir log un se woh seekhte jis se khaawand-o-biwi mein judaayi daal den aur dar-asl woh baghair Allah Taala ki marzi ke kisi ko koi nuqsaan nahi pahuncha sakte, yeh log woh seekhte hain jo unhe nuqsaan pahunchaaye aur nafa na pahuncha sake, aur woh ba-yaqeen jaante hain ke us ke lene wale ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi. Aur woh badtareen cheez hai jis ke badle woh apne aap ko farokht kar rahe hain, kaash ke yeh jaante hote.
ayahs.103: Agar yeh log saahib-e-imaan muttaqi ban jaate to Allah Taala ki taraf se behtareen sawaab unhe milta, agar yeh jaante hote.
ayahs.104: Aye imaan walo! Tum (Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam ko) 'raaina' na kaha karo, balke 'unzurna' kaho yani hamari taraf dekhiye aur sunte raha karo aur kaafiron ke liye dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.105: Na to ahl-e-kitaab ke kaafir aur na mushrikeen chaahte hain ke tum par tumhare Rabb ki koi bhalaayi naazil ho (un ke is hasad se kya hua) Allah Taala jise chaahe apni rehmat khusoosiyat se ata farmaaye, Allah Taala bade fazl wala hai.
ayahs.106: Jis aayat ko hum mansookh karden, ya bhula den us se behtar ya us jaisi aur laate hain, kya tu nahi jaanta ke Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.107: Kya tujhe ilm nahi ke zameen-o-aasmaan ka mulk Allah hi ke liye hai aur Allah ke siwa tumhara koi wali aur madadgaar nahi.
ayahs.108: Kya tum apne Rasool se yahi poochhna chaahte ho jo us se pehle Moosa (alaihis salaam) se poochha gaya tha? (Suno) imaan ko kufr se badalne wala seedhi raah se bhatak jaata hai.
ayahs.109: Un ahl-e-kitaab ke aksar log baa-wujood haq waazeh hojaane ke mahaz hasad-o-bughz ki bina par tumhe bhi imaan se hata dena chaahte hain, tum bhi maaf karo aur chhodo yahaan tak ke Allah Taala apna hukm laaye. Yaqeenan Allah Taala har cheez par qudrat rakhta hai.
ayahs.110: Tum namazen qaaim rakho aur zakaat dete raha karo aur jo kuch bhalaayi tum apne liye aage bhejo ge, sab kuch Allah ke paas paa lo ge, beshak Allah Taala tumhare aamaal ko khoob dekh raha hai.
ayahs.111: Yeh kehte hain ke jannat mein yahood-o-nasaara ke siwa aur koi na jaayega, yeh sirf un ki aarzooen hain, un se kaho ke agar tum sachche ho to koi daleel to pesh karo.
ayahs.112: Suno! Jo bhi apne aap ko khuloos ke saath Allah ke saamne jhuka de. Beshak use us ka Rabb poora badla dega, us par na to koi khauf hoga, na gham aur udaasi.
ayahs.113: Yahood kehte hain ke nasraani haq par nahi aur nasraani kehte hain ke yahoodi haq par nahi, haalaanke yeh sab log Taurat padhte hain. Isi tarah unhi jaisi baat be-ilm bhi kehte hain. Qayamat ke din Allah un ke is ikhtilaaf ka faisla un ke darmiyaan karde ga.
ayahs.114: Us shakhs se badh kar zaalim kaun hai jo Allah Taala ki masjidon mein Allah Taala ke zikr kiye jaane ko roke aur un ki barbaadi ki koshish kare, aise logon ko khauf khaate hue us mein jaana chaahiye, un ke liye dunya mein bhi ruswaayi hai aur aakhirat mein bhi bada azaab hai.
ayahs.115: Aur mashriq aur maghrib ka maalik Allah hi hai. Tum jidhar bhi munh karo udhar hi Allah ka munh hai, Allah Taala kushaadgi aur wusat wala aur bade ilm wala hai.
ayahs.116: Yeh kehte hain ke Allah Taala ki aulaad hai, (nahi balke) woh paak hai, zameen-o-aasmaan ki tamaam makhlooq us ki milkiyat mein hai aur har ek us ka farmaanbardaar hai.
ayahs.117: Woh zameen aur aasmaanon ka ibtidaa'an paida karne wala hai, woh jis kaam ko karna chaahe keh deta hai ke hoja, bas woh wahin hojaata hai.
ayahs.118: Isi tarah be-ilm logon ne bhi kaha ke khud Allah Taala hum se baaten kyun nahi karta, ya hamare paas koi nishaani kyun nahi aati? Isi tarah aisi hi baat un ke aglon ne bhi kahi thi, un ke aur un ke dil yaksaan hogaye, hum ne to yaqeen walon ke liye nishaaniyaan bayaan kardin.
ayahs.119: Hum ne aap ko haq ke saath khushkhabri dene wala aur daraane wala bana kar bheja hai aur jahannamiyon ke baare mein aap se pursish nahi hogi.
ayahs.120: Aap se yahood-o-nasaara hargiz raazi nahi honge jab tak ke aap un ke mazhab ke taabe na ban jaayen, aap keh dijiye ke Allah ki hidayat hi hidayat hai aur agar aap ne baa-wujood apne paas ilm aa jaane ke, phir un ki khwaahishon ki pairvi ki to Allah ke paas aap ka na to koi wali hoga aur na madadgaar.
ayahs.121: Jinhe hum ne kitaab di hai aur woh use padhne ke haq ke saath padhte hain, woh us kitaab par bhi imaan rakhte hain aur jo us ke saath kufr kare woh nuqsaan wala hai.
ayahs.122: Aye aulaad-e-Yaqoob! Main ne jo ne'maten tum par in'aam ki hain unhe yaad karo aur main ne to tumhe tamaam jahaanon par fazeelat de rakhi thi.
ayahs.123: Us din se daro jis din koi nafs kisi nafs ko kuch faaida na pahuncha sakega, na kisi shakhs se koi fidya qubool kiya jaayega, na use koi shafaa'at nafa degi, na un ki madad ki jaayegi.
ayahs.124: Jab Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ko un ke Rabb ne kai baaton se aazmaaya aur unhon ne sab ko poora kardiya to Allah ne farmaya ke main tumhe logon ka imaam bana doonga, arz karne lage: aur meri aulaad ko, farmaya mera waada zaalimon se nahi.
ayahs.125: Hum ne Baitullah ko logon ke liye sawaab aur amn-o-amaan ki jagah banaayi, tum Maqaam-e-Ibraheem ko jaaye-namaz muqarrar karlo, hum ne Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) aur Ismaeel (alaihis salaam) se waada liya ke tum mere ghar ko tawaaf karne walon aur aitikaaf karne walon aur ruku sajda karne walon ke liye paak saaf rakho.
ayahs.126: Jab Ibraheem ne kaha, aye parwardigaar! Tu is jagah ko amn wala shehar bana aur yahaan ke baashindon ko jo Allah Taala par aur qayamat ke din par imaan rakhne wale hon, phalon ki roziyaan de, Allah Taala ne farmaya: main kaafiron ko bhi thoda faaida doonga, phir unhe aag ke azaab ki taraf be-bas kardoonga, yeh pahunchne ki jagah buri hai.
ayahs.127: Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) aur Ismaeel (alaihis salaam) Kaaba ki buniyaaden aur deewaaren uthaate jaate the aur kehte jaa rahe the ke hamare parwardigaar! Tu hum se qubool farma, tu hi sunne wala aur jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.128: Aye hamare Rabb! Hamein apna farmaanbardaar bana le aur hamari aulaad mein se bhi ek jamaat ko apni itaa'at-guzaar rakh aur hamein apni ibaadaten sikha aur hamari tauba qubool farma, tu tauba qubool farmaane wala aur reham-o-karam karne wala hai.
ayahs.129: Aye hamare Rabb! In mein inhi mein se Rasool bhej jo un ke paas teri aayaten padhe, unhe kitaab-o-hikmat sikhaaye aur unhe paak kare, yaqeenan tu ghalba wala aur hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.130: Deen-e-Ibraheemi se wahi be-raghbati karega jo mahaz bewaqoof ho, hum ne to use dunya mein bhi barguzeeda kiya tha aur aakhirat mein bhi woh nekokaaron mein se hai.
ayahs.131: Jab kabhi bhi unhe un ke Rabb ne kaha, farmaanbardaar hoja, unhon ne kaha, main ne Rabb-ul-aalameen ki farmaanbardaari ki.
ayahs.132: Isi ki wasiyat Ibraheem aur Yaqoob ne apni aulaad ko ki, ke hamare bachcho! Allah Taala ne tumhare liye is deen ko pasand farma liya hai, khabardaar! Tum musalmaan hi marna.
ayahs.133: Kya (Hazrat) Yaqoob ke intiqaal ke waqt tum maujood the? Jab unhon ne apni aulaad ko kaha ke mere baad tum kis ki ibaadat karo ge? To sab ne jawaab diya ke aap ke mabood ki aur aap ke aabaa-o-ajdaad Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) aur Ismaeel (alaihis salaam) aur Ishaaq (alaihis salaam) ke mabood ki jo mabood ek hi hai aur hum usi ke farmaanbardaar rahenge.
ayahs.134: Yeh jamaat to guzar chuki, jo unhon ne kiya woh un ke liye hai aur jo tum karo ge tumhare liye hai. Un ke aamaal ke baare mein tum nahi poochhe jaao ge.
ayahs.135: Yeh kehte hain ke yahood-o-nasaara ban jaao to hidayat paao ge. Tum kaho balke saheeh raah par millat-e-Ibraheemi wale hain, aur Ibraheem khaalis Allah ke parastaar the aur mushrik na the.
ayahs.136: Aye musalmaano! Tum sab kaho ke hum Allah par imaan laaye aur us cheez par bhi jo hamari taraf utaari gayi aur jo cheez Ibraheem, Ismaeel, Ishaaq, Yaqoob (alaihimus salaam) aur un ki aulaad par utaari gayi aur jo kuch Allah ki jaanib se Moosa aur Eesa (alaihimas salaam) aur doosre ambiya (alaihimus salaam) diye gaye. Hum un mein se kisi ke darmiyaan farq nahi karte, hum Allah ke farmaanbardaar hain.
ayahs.137: Agar woh tum jaisa imaan laayen to hidayat paayen, aur agar munh moden to woh sareeh ikhtilaaf mein hain, Allah Taala un se anqareeb aap ki kifaayat karega aur woh khoob sunne aur jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.138: Allah ka rang ikhtiyaar karo aur Allah Taala se achha rang kis ka hoga? Hum to usi ki ibaadat karne wale hain.
ayahs.139: Aap keh dijiye kya tum hum se Allah ke baare mein jhagadte ho jo hamara aur tumhara Rabb hai, hamare liye hamare aamaal hain aur tumhare liye tumhare aamaal, hum to usi ke liye mukhlis hain.
ayahs.140: Kya tum kehte ho ke Ibraheem aur Ismaeel aur Ishaaq aur Yaqoob (alaihimus salaam) aur un ki aulaad yahoodi ya nasraani the? Keh do ke kya tum ziyaada jaante ho, ya Allah Taala? Allah ke paas shahaadat chhupaane wale se ziyaada zaalim aur kaun hai? Aur Allah tumhare kaamon se ghaafil nahi.
ayahs.141: Yeh ummat hai jo guzar chuki, jo unhon ne kiya un ke liye hai aur jo tum ne kiya tumhare liye, tum un ke aamaal ke baare mein sawaal na kiye jaao ge.
ayahs.142: Anqareeb naadaan log kahenge ke jis qibla par yeh the us se unhe kis cheez ne hataaya? Aap keh dijiye ke mashriq-o-maghrib ka maalik Allah Taala hi hai, woh jise chaahe seedhi raah ki hidayat karde.
ayahs.143: Hum ne isi tarah tumhe aadil ummat banaya hai taake tum logon par gawaah hojaao aur Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) tum par gawaah hojaayen, jis qibla par tum pehle se the use hum ne sirf is liye muqarrar kiya tha ke hum jaan len ke Rasool ka sachcha taabedaar kaun hai aur kaun hai jo apni ediyon ke bal palat jaata hai, go yeh kaam mushkil hai, magar jinhe Allah ne hidayat di hai (un par koi mushkil nahi) Allah Taala tumhare imaan zaaya na karega, Allah Taala logon ke saath shafqat aur meharbaani karne wala hai.
ayahs.144: Hum aap ke chehre ko baar baar aasmaan ki taraf uthte hue dekh rahe hain, ab hum aap ko us qibla ki jaanib mutawajjah karenge jis se aap khush hojaayen, aap apna munh Masjid-e-Haraam ki taraf pher len aur aap jahaan kahin hon apna munh usi taraf phera karen. Ahl-e-kitaab ko is baat ke Allah ki taraf se bar-haq hone ka qat'ee ilm hai aur Allah Taala un aamaal se ghaafil nahi jo yeh karte hain.
ayahs.145: Aur aap agarche ahl-e-kitaab ko tamaam daleelen de den lekin woh aap ke qible ki pairvi nahi karenge aur na aap un ke qible ko maanne wale hain aur na yeh aapas mein ek doosre ke qible ko maanne wale hain aur agar aap baa-wujoodyeke aap ke paas ilm aa chuka phir bhi un ki khwaahishon ke peechhe lag jaayen to ba-yaqeen aap bhi zaalimon mein se hojaayenge.
ayahs.146: Jinhe hum ne kitaab di hai woh to use aisa pehchaante hain jaise koi apne bachchon ko pehchaane, un ki ek jamaat haq ko pehchaan kar phir chhupaati hai.
ayahs.147: Aap ke Rabb ki taraf se yeh saraasar haq hai, khabardaar aap shak karne walon mein se na hona.
ayahs.148: Har shakhs ek na ek taraf mutawajjah ho raha hai, tum nekiyon ki taraf daudo. Jahaan kahin bhi tum hoge, Allah tumhe le aayega. Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.149: Aap jahaan se niklen apna munh (namaz ke liye) Masjid-e-Haraam ki taraf karliya karen, yahi haq hai aap ke Rabb ki taraf se, jo kuch tum kar rahe ho us se Allah Taala be-khabar nahi.
ayahs.150: Aur jis jagah se aap niklen apna munh Masjid-e-Haraam ki taraf pher len aur jahaan kahin tum ho apne chehre usi taraf kiya karo taake logon ki koi hujjat tum par baaqi na reh jaaye siwaaye un logon ke jinhon ne un mein se zulm kiya hai, tum un se na daro mujh hi se daro aur taake main apni ne'mat tum par poori karoon aur is liye bhi ke tum raah-e-raast paao.
ayahs.151: Jis tarah hum ne tum mein tumhi mein se Rasool bheja jo hamari aayaten tumhare saamne tilaawat karta hai aur tumhe paak karta hai aur tumhe kitaab-o-hikmat aur woh cheezen sikhaata hai jin se tum be-ilm the.
ayahs.152: Is liye tum mera zikr karo, main bhi tumhe yaad karoonga, meri shukrguzaari karo aur naashukri se bacho.
ayahs.153: Aye imaan walo! Sabr aur namaz ke zariye madad chaaho, Allah Taala sabr walon ka saath deta hai.
ayahs.154: Aur Allah Taala ki raah ke shaheedon ko murda mat kaho, woh zinda hain, lekin tum nahi samajhte.
ayahs.155: Aur hum kisi na kisi tarah tumhari aazmaaish zaroor karenge, dushman ke dar se, bhook pyaas se, maal-o-jaan aur phalon ki kami se aur un sabr karne walon ko khushkhabri de dijiye.
ayahs.156: Jinhe, jab kabhi koi museebat aati hai to keh diya karte hain ke hum to khud Allah Taala ki milkiyat hain aur hum usi ki taraf lautne wale hain.
ayahs.157: Un par un ke Rabb ki nawaazishen aur rehmaten hain aur yahi log hidayat-yaafta hain.
ayahs.158: Safa aur Marwa Allah Taala ki nishaaniyon mein se hain, is liye Baitullah ka hajj-o-umra karne wale par un ka tawaaf karlene mein bhi koi gunaah nahi, apni khushi se bhalaayi karne walon ka Allah qadardaan hai aur unhe khoob jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.159: Jo log hamari utaari hui daleelon aur hidayat ko chhupaate hain baa-wujoodyeke hum use apni kitaab mein logon ke liye bayaan kar chuke hain, un logon par Allah ki aur tamaam laanat karne walon ki laanat hai.
ayahs.160: Magar woh log jo tauba karlen aur islaah karlen aur bayaan karden, to main un ki tauba qubool karleta hoon aur main tauba qubool karne wala aur reham-o-karam karne wala hoon.
ayahs.161: Yaqeenan jo kuffaar apne kufr mein hi mar jaayen, un par Allah Taala ki, farishton ki aur tamaam logon ki laanat hai.
ayahs.162: Jis mein yeh hamesha rahenge, na un se azaab halka kiya jaayega aur na unhe dheel di jaayegi.
ayahs.163: Tum sab ka mabood ek hi mabood hai, us ke siwa koi mabood bar-haq nahi, woh bahut reham karne wala aur bada meharbaan hai.
ayahs.164: Aasmaanon aur zameen ki paidaaish, raat din ka herpher, kashtiyon ka logon ko nafa dene wali cheezon ko liye hue samundron mein chalna, aasmaan se paani utaar kar, murda zameen ko zinda kardena, us mein har qism ke jaanwaron ko phaila dena, hawaaon ke rukh badalna, aur baadal, jo aasmaan aur zameen ke darmiyaan musakhkhar hain, un mein aqlmandon ke liye qudrat-e-ilaahi ki nishaaniyaan hain.
ayahs.165: Baaz log aise bhi hain jo Allah ke shareek auron ko thahra kar un se aisi muhabbat rakhte hain, jaisi muhabbat Allah se honi chaahiye aur imaan wale Allah ki muhabbat mein bahut sakht hote hain, kaash ke mushrik log jaante jab ke Allah ke azaab ko dekh kar (jaan lenge) ke tamaam taaqat Allah hi ko hai aur Allah Taala sakht azaab dene wala hai (to hargiz shirk na karte).
ayahs.166: Jis waqt peshwa log apne taabedaaron se bezaar hojaayenge aur azaab ko apni aankhon se dekh lenge aur kul rishte naate toot jaayenge.
ayahs.167: Aur taabedaar log kehne lagenge, kaash hum dunya ki taraf dobaara jaayen to hum bhi un se aise hi bezaar hojaayen jaise yeh hum se hain, isi tarah Allah Taala unhe un ke aamaal dikhaayega un ko hasrat dilaane ko, yeh hargiz jahannam se na niklenge.
ayahs.168: Logo! Zameen mein jitni bhi halaal aur paakeeza cheezen hain unhe khaao piyo aur shaitaani raah par na chalo, woh tumhara khula hua dushman hai.
ayahs.169: Woh tumhe sirf buraayi aur be-hayaayi ka aur Allah Taala par un baaton ke kehne ka hukm deta hai jin ka tumhe ilm nahi.
ayahs.170: Aur un se jab kabhi kaha jaata hai ke Allah Taala ki utaari hui kitaab ki taabedaari karo to jawaab dete hain ke hum to us tareeqe ki pairvi karenge jis par hum ne apne baap daadon ko paaya, go un ke baap daade be-aql aur gum-karda-raah hon.
ayahs.171: Kuffaar ki misaal un jaanwaron ki tarah hai jo apne charwaahe ki sirf pukaar aur aawaaz hi ko sunte hain (samajhte nahi) woh behre, goonge aur andhe hain, unhe aql nahi.
ayahs.172: Aye imaan walo! Jo paakeeza cheezen hum ne tumhe de rakhi hain unhe khaao, piyo aur Allah Taala ka shukr karo, agar tum khaas usi ki ibaadat karte ho.
ayahs.173: Tum par murda aur (baha hua) khoon aur soor ka gosht aur har woh cheez jis par Allah ke siwa doosron ka naam pukaara gaya ho haraam hai, phir jo majboor hojaaye aur woh hadd se badhne wala aur ziyaadati karne wala na ho, us par un ke khaane mein koi gunaah nahi, Allah Taala bakhshish karne wala meharbaan hai.
ayahs.174: Beshak jo log Allah Taala ki utaari hui kitaab chhupaate hain aur use thodi thodi si qeemat par bechte hain, yaqeen maano ke yeh apne pet mein aag bhar rahe hain, qayamat ke din Allah Taala un se baat bhi na karega, na unhe paak karega, balke un ke liye dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.175: Yeh woh log hain jinhon ne gumraahi ko hidayat ke badle aur azaab ko maghfirat ke badle khareed liya hai, yeh log aag ka azaab kitna bardaasht karne wale hain.
ayahs.176: Un azaabon ka baa'is yahi hai ke Allah Taala ne sachchi kitaab utaari aur us kitaab mein ikhtilaaf karne wale yaqeenan door ke khilaaf mein hain.
ayahs.177: Saari achhaayi mashriq-o-maghrib ki taraf munh karne mein hi nahi balke haqeeqatan achha woh shakhs hai jo Allah Taala par, qayamat ke din par, farishton par, kitaabullah par aur nabiyon par imaan rakhne wala ho, jo maal se muhabbat karne ke baa-wujood qaraabatdaaron, yateemon, miskeenon, musaafiron aur sawaal karne wale ko de, ghulaamon ko aazaad kare, namaz ki paabandi aur zakaat ki adaayegi kare, jab waada kare tab use poora kare, tangdasti, dukh dard aur ladaayi ke waqt sabr kare, yahi sachche log hain aur yahi parhezgaar hain.
ayahs.178: Aye imaan walo! Tum par maqtoolon ka qisaas lena farz kiya gaya hai, aazaad aazaad ke badle, ghulaam ghulaam ke badle, aurat aurat ke badle. Haan jis kisi ko us ke bhaai ki taraf se kuch maafi de di jaaye use bhalaayi ki ittebaa karni chaahiye aur aasaani ke saath diyat ada karni chaahiye. Tumhare Rabb ki taraf se yeh takhfeef aur rehmat hai, us ke baad bhi jo sarkashi kare use dardnaak azaab hoga.
ayahs.179: Aqlmando! Qisaas mein tumhare liye zindagi hai, is baa'is tum (qatl-e-naahaq se) ruko ge.
ayahs.180: Tum par farz kar diya gaya hai ke jab tum mein se koi marne lage aur maal chhod jaata ho to apne maa baap aur qaraabatdaaron ke liye achhaayi ke saath wasiyat kar jaaye, parhezgaron par yeh haq aur saabit hai.
ayahs.181: Ab jo shakhs use sunne ke baad badal de us ka gunaah badalne wale par hi hoga, waaqee Allah Taala sunne wala jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.182: Haan jo shakhs wasiyat karne wale ki jaanibdaari ya gunaah ki wasiyat kar dene se dare pas woh un mein aapas mein islaah karaade to us par gunaah nahi, Allah Taala bakhshne wala meharbaan hai.
ayahs.183: Aye imaan walo! Tum par roze rakhna farz kiya gaya jis tarah tum se pehle logon par farz kiye gaye the, taake tum taqwa ikhtiyaar karo.
ayahs.184: Ginti ke chand hi din hain lekin tum mein se jo shakhs bimaar ho ya safar mein ho to woh aur dinon mein ginti ko poora kar le aur us ki taaqat rakhne wale fidye mein ek miskeen ko khaana den, phir jo shakhs neki mein sabqat kare woh usi ke liye behtar hai lekin tumhare haq mein behtar kaam roze rakhna hi hai, agar tum baa-ilm ho.
ayahs.185: Maah-e-Ramzaan woh hai jis mein Qur'an utaara gaya jo logon ko hidayat karne wala hai aur jis mein hidayat ki aur haq-o-baatil ki tameez ki nishaaniyaan hain, tum mein se jo shakhs is maheene ko paaye use roza rakhna chaahiye, haan jo bimaar ho ya musaafir ho use doosre dinon mein yeh ginti poori karni chaahiye, Allah Taala ka iraada tumhare saath aasaani ka hai, sakhti ka nahi, woh chaahta hai ke tum ginti poori karlo aur Allah Taala ki di hui hidayat par us ki badaaiyaan bayaan karo aur us ka shukr karo.
ayahs.186: Aur jab mere bande mere baare mein aap se sawaal karen to aap keh den ke main bahut hi qareeb hoon, har pukaarne wale ki pukaar ko jab kabhi woh mujhe pukaare, qubool karta hoon, is liye logon ko bhi chaahiye ke woh meri baat maan liya karen aur mujh par imaan rakhen, yahi un ki bhalaayi ka baa'is hai.
ayahs.187: Roze ki raaton mein apni biwiyon se milna tumhare liye halaal kiya gaya, woh tumhara libaas hain aur tum un ke libaas ho, tumhari posheeda khiyaanaton ka Allah Taala ko ilm hai, us ne tumhari tauba qubool farma kar tum se darguzar farma liya, ab tumhe un se mubaasharat ki aur Allah Taala ki likhi hui cheez ko talaash karne ki ijaazat hai, tum khaate peete raho yahaan tak ke subah ka safaid dhaaga siyaah dhaage se zaahir hojaaye. Phir raat tak roze ko poora karo aur aurton se us waqt mubaasharat na karo jab ke tum masjidon mein aitikaaf mein ho. Yeh Allah Taala ki hudood hain, tum un ke qareeb bhi na jaao. Isi tarah Allah Taala apni aayaten logon ke liye bayaan farmaata hai taake woh bachen.
ayahs.188: Aur ek doosre ka maal naahaq na khaaya karo, na haakimon ko rishwat pahuncha kar kisi ka kuch maal zulm-o-sitam se apna kar liya karo, haalaanke tum jaante ho.
ayahs.189: Log aap se chaand ke baare mein sawaal karte hain, aap keh dijiye ke yeh logon (ki ibaadat) ke waqton aur hajj ke mausam ke liye hai (ehraam ki haalat mein) aur gharon ke peechhe se tumhara aana kuch neki nahi, balke neki wala woh hai jo muttaqi ho. Aur gharon mein to darwaazon mein se aaya karo aur Allah se darte raho, taake tum kaamyaab hojaao.
ayahs.190: Lado Allah ki raah mein un se jo tum se ladte hain aur ziyaadati na karo, Allah Taala ziyaadati karne walon ko pasand nahi farmaata.
ayahs.191: Unhe maaro jahaan bhi paao aur unhe nikaalo jahaan se unhon ne tumhe nikaala hai aur (suno) fitna qatl se ziyaada sakht hai aur Masjid-e-Haraam ke paas un se ladaayi na karo jab tak ke yeh khud tum se na laden, agar yeh tum se laden to tum bhi unhe maaro, kaafiron ka badla yahi hai.
ayahs.192: Agar yeh baaz aa jaayen to Allah Taala bakhshne wala meharbaan hai.
ayahs.193: Un se lado jab tak ke fitna na mit jaaye aur Allah Taala ka deen ghaalib na aa jaaye, agar yeh ruk jaayen (to tum bhi ruk jaao) ziyaadati to sirf zaalimon par hi hai.
ayahs.194: Hurmat wale maheene hurmat wale maheenon ke badle hain aur hurmaten adle badle ki hain, jo tum par ziyaadati kare tum bhi us par usi ke misl ziyaadati karo jo tum par ki hai aur Allah Taala se darte raha karo aur jaan rakho ke Allah Taala parhezgaron ke saath hai.
ayahs.195: Allah Taala ki raah mein kharch karo aur apne haathon halaakat mein na pado aur sulook-o-ehsaan karo, Allah Taala ehsaan karne walon ko dost rakhta hai.
ayahs.196: Hajj aur umre ko Allah Taala ke liye poora karo, haan agar tum rok liye jaao to jo qurbaani mayassar ho, use kar daalo aur apne sar na mundwaao jab tak ke qurbaani qurbaan-gaah tak na pahunch jaaye, albatta tum mein se jo bimaar ho, ya us ke sar mein koi takleef ho (jis ki wajah se sar mundaale) to us par fidya hai, khwaah roze rakh le, khwaah sadqa de de, khwaah qurbaani kare, pas jab tum amn ki haalat mein hojaao to jo shakhs umre se le kar hajj tak tamattu kare, pas use jo qurbaani mayassar ho use kar daale, jise taaqat hi na ho woh teen roze to hajj ke dinon mein rakh le aur saat waapsi mein, yeh poore das hogaye. Yeh hukm un ke liye hai jo Masjid-e-Haraam ke rehne wale na hon, logo! Allah se darte raho aur jaan lo ke Allah Taala sakht azaab wala hai.
ayahs.197: Hajj ke maheene muqarrar hain, is liye jo shakhs un mein hajj laazim karle woh apni biwi se mel milaap karne, gunaah karne aur ladaayi jhagade karne se bachta rahe, tum jo neki karo ge us se Allah Taala baa-khabar hai aur apne saath safar-kharch le liya karo, sab se behtar tosha Allah Taala ka dar hai aur aye aqlmando! Mujh se darte raha karo.
ayahs.198: Tum par apne Rabb ka fazl talaash karne mein koi gunaah nahi, jab tum Arafaat se lauto to Mash'ar-e-Haraam ke paas zikr-e-ilaahi karo aur us ka zikr karo jaise ke us ne tumhe hidayat di, haalaanke tum us se pehle raah bhoole hue the.
ayahs.199: Phir tum us jagah se lauto jis jagah se sab log lautte hain aur Allah Taala se talab-e-bakhshish karte raho, yaqeenan Allah Taala bakhshne wala meharbaan hai.
ayahs.200: Phir jab tum arkaan-e-hajj ada kar chuko to Allah Taala ka zikr karo jis tarah tum apne baap daadon ka zikr kiya karte the, balke us se bhi ziyaada, baaz log woh bhi hain jo kehte hain aye hamare Rabb! Hamein dunya mein de. Aise logon ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi.
ayahs.201: Aur baaz log woh bhi hain jo kehte hain aye hamare Rabb! Hamein dunya mein neki de aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalaayi ata farma aur hamein azaab-e-jahannam se najaat de.
ayahs.202: Yeh woh log hain jin ke liye un ke aamaal ka hissa hai aur Allah Taala jald hisaab lene wala hai.
ayahs.203: Aur Allah Taala ki yaad un ginti ke chand dinon (ayyaam-e-tashreeq) mein karo, do din ki jaldi karne wale par bhi koi gunaah nahi, aur jo peechhe reh jaaye us par bhi koi gunaah nahi, yeh parhezgaar ke liye hai aur Allah Taala se darte raho aur jaan rakho ke tum sab usi ki taraf jama kiye jaao ge.
ayahs.204: Baaz logon ki dunyaawi gharaz ki baaten aap ko khush kar deti hain aur woh apne dil ki baaton par Allah ko gawaah karta hai, haalaanke dar-asl woh zabardast jhagdaalu hai.
ayahs.205: Jab woh laut kar jaata hai to zameen mein fasaad phailaane ki aur kheti aur nasl ki barbaadi ki koshish mein laga rehta hai aur Allah Taala fasaad ko naapasand karta hai.
ayahs.206: Aur jab us se kaha jaaye ke Allah se dar to takabbur aur ta'assub use gunaah par aamaada kar deta hai, aise ke liye bas jahannam hi hai aur yaqeenan woh badtareen jagah hai.
ayahs.207: Aur baaz log woh bhi hain ke Allah Taala ki razaamandi ki talab mein apni jaan tak bech daalte hain aur Allah Taala apne bandon par badi meharbaani karne wala hai.
ayahs.208: Imaan walo! Islam mein poore poore daakhil hojaao aur shaitaan ke qadmon ki taabedaari na karo, woh tumhara khula dushman hai.
ayahs.209: Agar tum baa-wujood tumhare paas daleelen aa jaane ke bhi phisal jaao to jaan lo ke Allah Taala ghalba wala aur hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.210: Kya logon ko is baat ka intizaar hai ke un ke paas khud Allah Taala abr ke saaibaanon mein aa jaaye aur farishte bhi aur kaam inteha tak pahuncha diya jaaye, Allah hi ki taraf tamaam kaam lautaaye jaate hain.
ayahs.211: Bani Israeel se poochho to ke hum ne unhe kis qadar roshan nishaaniyaan ata farmaayin aur jo shakhs Allah Taala ki ne'maton ko apne paas pahunch jaane ke baad badal daale (woh jaan le) ke Allah Taala bhi sakht azaabon wala hai.
ayahs.212: Kaafiron ke liye dunya ki zindagi khoob zeenatdaar ki gayi hai, woh imaan walon se hansi mazaaq karte hain, haalaanke parhezgaar log qayamat ke din un se aala honge, Allah Taala jise chaahta hai be-hisaab rozi deta hai.
ayahs.213: Dar-asl log ek hi grooh the, Allah Taala ne nabiyon ko khushkhabriyaan dene aur daraane wala bana kar bheja aur un ke saath sachchi kitaaben naazil farmaayin, taake logon ke har ikhtilaafi amr ka faisla hojaaye. Aur sirf unhi logon ne jinhe kitaab di gayi thi, apne paas dalaail aa chukne ke baad aapas ke bughz-o-inaad ki wajah se us mein ikhtilaaf kiya, is liye Allah paak ne imaan walon ki us ikhtilaaf mein bhi haq ki taraf apni mashee'at se rahbari ki aur Allah jis ko chaahe seedhi raah ki taraf rahbari karta hai.
ayahs.214: Kya tum yeh gumaan kiye baithe ho ke jannat mein chale jaao ge, haalaanke ab tak tum par woh haalaat nahi aaye jo tum se agle logon par aaye the. Unhe bimaariyaan aur museebaten pahunchin aur woh yahaan tak jhanjhode gaye ke Rasool aur us ke saath ke imaan wale kehne lage ke Allah ki madad kab aayegi? Sun rakho ke Allah ki madad qareeb hi hai.
ayahs.215: Aap se poochhte hain ke woh kya kharch karen? Aap keh dijiye jo maal tum kharch karo woh maa baap ke liye hai aur rishtedaaron aur yateemon aur miskeenon aur musaafiron ke liye hai aur tum jo kuch bhalaayi karo ge Allah Taala ko us ka ilm hai.
ayahs.216: Tum par jihaad farz kiya gaya go woh tumhe dushwaar maaloom ho, mumkin hai ke tum kisi cheez ko buri jaano aur dar-asl wahi tumhare liye bhali ho aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke tum kisi cheez ko achhi samjho, haalaanke woh tumhare liye buri ho, haqeeqi ilm Allah hi ko hai, tum mahaz be-khabar ho.
ayahs.217: Log aap se hurmat wale maheenon mein ladaayi ki baabat sawaal karte hain, aap keh dijiye ke un mein ladaayi karna bada gunaah hai, lekin Allah ki raah se rokna, us ke saath kufr karna aur Masjid-e-Haraam se rokna aur wahaan ke rehne walon ko wahaan se nikaalna, Allah ke nazdeek us se bhi bada gunaah hai, yeh fitna qatl se bhi bada gunaah hai, yeh log tum se ladaayi bhidaayi karte hi rahenge yahaan tak ke agar un se hosake to tumhe tumhare deen se murtad karden aur tum mein se jo log apne deen se palat jaayen aur usi kufr ki haalat mein maren, un ke aamaal dunyawi aur ukhrawi sab ghaarat hojaayenge. Yeh log jahannami honge aur hamesha hamesha jahannam mein hi rahenge.
ayahs.218: Albatta imaan laane wale, hijrat karne wale, Allah ki raah mein jihaad karne wale hi rehmat-e-ilaahi ke ummeedwaar hain, Allah Taala bahut bakhshne wala aur bahut meharbaani karne wala hai.
ayahs.219: Log aap se sharaab aur jue ka mas'ala poochhte hain, aap keh dijiye in dono mein bahut bada gunaah hai aur logon ko us se dunyaawi faaida bhi hota hai, lekin un ka gunaah un ke nafa se bahut ziyaada hai. Aap se yeh bhi daryaaft karte hain ke kya kuch kharch karen? To aap keh dijiye haajat se zaaid cheez, Allah Taala isi tarah apne ahkaam saaf saaf tumhare liye bayaan farma raha hai, taake tum soch samajh sako.
ayahs.220: Dunya aur aakhirat ke umoor ko. Aur tujh se yateemon ke baare mein bhi sawaal karte hain, aap keh dijiye ke un ki khairkhwaahi behtar hai, tum agar un ka maal apne maal mein mila bhi lo to woh tumhare bhaai hain, badniyat aur nek-niyat har ek ko Allah khoob jaanta hai aur agar Allah chaahta to tumhe mashaqqat mein daal deta, yaqeenan Allah Taala ghalba wala aur hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.221: Aur shirk karne wali aurton se taa-waqteeke woh imaan na laayen tum nikaah na karo, imaan wali laundi bhi shirk karne wali aazaad aurat se bahut behtar hai, go tumhe mushrika hi achhi lagti ho aur na shirk karne wale mardon ke nikaah mein apni aurton ko do jab tak ke woh imaan na laayen, imaan wala ghulaam aazaad mushrik se behtar hai, go mushrik tumhe achha lage. Yeh log jahannam ki taraf bulaate hain aur Allah jannat ki taraf aur apni bakhshish ki taraf apne hukm se bulaata hai, woh apni aayaten logon ke liye bayaan farma raha hai, taake woh naseehat haasil karen.
ayahs.222: Aap se haiz ke baare mein sawaal karte hain, keh dijiye ke woh gandagi hai, haalat-e-haiz mein aurton se alag raho aur jab tak woh paak na hojaayen un ke qareeb na jaao, haan jab woh paak hojaayen to un ke paas jaao jahaan se Allah ne tumhe ijaazat di hai, Allah tauba karne walon ko aur paak rehne walon ko pasand farmaata hai.
ayahs.223: Tumhari biwiyaan tumhari khetiyaan hain, apni khetiyon mein jis tarah chaaho aao aur apne liye (nek aamaal) aage bhejo aur Allah Taala se darte raha karo aur jaan rakho ke tum us se milne wale ho aur imaan walon ko khushkhabri suna dijiye.
ayahs.224: Aur Allah Taala ko apni qasmon ka (is tarah) nishaana na banao ke bhalaayi aur parhezgaari aur logon ke darmiyaan ki islaah ko chhod baitho aur Allah Taala sunne wala jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.225: Allah Taala tumhe tumhari un qasmon par na pakdega jo pukhta na hon, haan us ki pakad us cheez par hai jo tumhare dilon ka fe'l ho, Allah Taala bakhshne wala aur burdbaar hai.
ayahs.226: Jo log apni biwiyon se (taalluq na rakhne ki) qasmen khaayen, un ke liye chaar maheene ki muddat hai, phir agar woh laut aayen to Allah Taala bhi bakhshne wala meharbaan hai.
ayahs.227: Aur agar talaaq ka hi qasd karlen to Allah Taala sunne wala, jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.228: Talaaq wali aurten apne aap ko teen haiz tak roke rakhen, unhe halaal nahi ke Allah ne un ke reham mein jo paida kiya ho use chhupaayen, agar unhe Allah Taala par aur qayamat ke din par imaan ho, un ke khaawand us muddat mein unhe lauta lene ke poore haqdaar hain agar un ka iraada islaah ka ho. Aur aurton ke bhi waise hi haq hain jaise un par mardon ke hain achhaayi ke saath. Haan mardon ko aurton par fazeelat hai aur Allah Taala ghaalib hai hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.229: Yeh talaaqen do martaba hain, phir ya to achhaayi se rokna ya umdagi ke saath chhod dena hai aur tumhe halaal nahi ke tum ne unhe jo de diya hai us mein se kuch bhi lo, haan yeh aur baat hai ke dono ko Allah ki hadden qaaim na rakh sakne ka khauf ho, is liye agar tumhe dar ho ke yeh dono Allah ki hadden qaaim na rakh sakenge to aurat rihaayi paane ke liye kuch de daale, us mein dono par gunaah nahi, yeh Allah ki hudood hain khabardaar un se aage na badhna aur jo log Allah ki hadon se tajaawuz karjaayen woh zaalim hain.
ayahs.230: Phir agar us ko (teesri baar) talaaq de de to ab us ke liye halaal nahi jab tak woh aurat us ke siwa doosre se nikaah na kare, phir agar woh bhi talaaq de de to un dono ko mel jol karlene mein koi gunaah nahi ba-shart-yeke yeh jaan len ke Allah ki hadon ko qaaim rakh sakenge, yeh Allah Taala ki hudood hain jinhe woh jaanne walon ke liye bayaan farma raha hai.
ayahs.231: Jab tum aurton ko talaaq do aur woh apni iddat khatm karne par aayen to ab unhe achhi tarah basaao, ya bhalaayi ke saath alag kardo aur unhe takleef pahunchaane ki gharaz se zulm-o-ziyaadati ke liye na roko, jo shakhs aisa kare us ne apni jaan par zulm kiya. Tum Allah ke ahkaam ko hansi khel na banao aur Allah ka ehsaan jo tum par hai yaad karo aur jo kuch kitaab-o-hikmat us ne naazil farmaayi hai jis se tumhe naseehat kar raha hai, use bhi. Aur Allah Taala se darte raha karo aur jaan rakho ke Allah Taala har cheez ko jaanta hai.
ayahs.232: Aur jab tum apni aurton ko talaaq do aur woh apni iddat poori karlen to unhe un ke khaawandon se nikaah karne se na roko jab ke woh aapas mein dastoor ke mutaabiq razaamand hon. Yeh naseehat unhe ki jaati hai jinhe tum mein se Allah Taala par aur qayamat ke din par yaqeen-o-imaan ho, us mein tumhari behtareen safaayi aur paakeezgi hai. Allah Taala jaanta hai aur tum nahi jaante.
ayahs.233: Maayen apni aulaad ko do saal kaamil doodh pilaayen jin ka iraada doodh pilaane ki muddat bilkul poori karne ka ho aur jin ke bachche hain un ke zimme un ka roti kapda hai jo mutaabiq dastoor ke ho. Har shakhs itni hi takleef diya jaata hai jitni us ki taaqat ho. Maa ko us ke bachche ki wajah se ya baap ko us ki aulaad ki wajah se koi zarar na pahunchaaya jaaye. Waaris par bhi isi jaisi zimmedaari hai, phir agar dono (yani maa baap) apni razaamandi aur baahami mashware se doodh chhudaana chaahen to dono par kuch gunaah nahi aur agar tumhara iraada apni aulaad ko doodh pilwaane ka ho to bhi tum par koi gunaah nahi jab ke tum un ko mutaabiq dastoor ke jo dena ho woh un ke hawaale kardo, Allah Taala se darte raho aur jaante raho ke Allah Taala tumhare aamaal ki dekh bhaal kar raha hai.
ayahs.234: Tum mein se jo log faut hojaayen aur biwiyaan chhod jaayen, woh aurten apne aap ko chaar maheene aur das (din) iddat mein rakhen, phir jab muddat khatm karlen to jo achhaayi ke saath woh apne liye karen us mein tum par koi gunaah nahi aur Allah Taala tumhare har amal se khabardaar hai.
ayahs.235: Tum par is mein koi gunaah nahi ke tum ishaaratan kinaayatan un aurton se nikaah ki baabat kaho, ya apne dil mein posheeda iraada karo, Allah Taala ko ilm hai ke tum zaroor un ko yaad karo ge, lekin tum un se posheeda waade na karlo, haan yeh aur baat hai ke tum bhali baat bola karo aur aqd-e-nikaah jab tak ke iddat khatm na hojaaye pukhta na karo, jaan rakho ke Allah Taala ko tumhare dilon ki baaton ka bhi ilm hai, tum us se khauf khaate raha karo aur yeh bhi jaan rakho ke Allah Taala bakhshish aur ilm wala hai.
ayahs.236: Agar tum aurton ko baghair haath lagaaye aur baghair mehr muqarrar kiye talaaq de do to bhi tum par koi gunaah nahi, haan unhe kuch na kuch faaida do. Khushhaal apne andaaz se aur tangdast apni taaqat ke mutaabiq dastoor ke mutaabiq achha faaida de. Bhalaayi karne walon par yeh laazim hai.
ayahs.237: Aur agar tum aurton ko us se pehle talaaq de do ke tum ne unhe haath lagaaya ho aur tum ne un ka mehr bhi muqarrar kardiya ho to muqarrara mehr ka aadha mehr de do, yeh aur baat hai ke woh khud maaf karden ya woh shakhs maaf karde jis ke haath mein nikaah ki girah hai, tumhara maaf kardena taqwa se bahut nazdeek hai aur aapas ki fazeelat aur buzurgi ko faraamosh na karo, yaqeenan Allah Taala tumhare aamaal ko dekh raha hai.
ayahs.238: Namaazon ki hifaazat karo, bilkhusoos darmiyaan wali namaz ki aur Allah Taala ke liye baa-adab khade raha karo.
ayahs.239: Agar tumhe khauf ho to paidal hi sahi ya sawaar hi sahi, haan jab amn hojaaye to Allah ka zikr karo jis tarah ke us ne tumhe is baat ki taaleem di jise tum nahi jaante the.
ayahs.240: Jo log tum mein se faut hojaayen aur biwiyaan chhod jaayen woh wasiyat kar jaayen ke un ki biwiyaan saal bhar tak faaida uthaayen unhe koi na nikaale, haan agar woh khud nikal jaayen to tum par us mein koi gunaah nahi jo woh apne liye achhaayi se karen, Allah Taala ghaalib aur hakeem hai.
ayahs.241: Talaaq waaliyon ko achhi tarah faaida dena parhezgaron par laazim hai.
ayahs.242: Allah Taala isi tarah apni aayaten tum par zaahir farma raha hai taake tum samjho.
ayahs.243: Kya tum ne unhe nahi dekha jo hazaaron ki taadaad mein the aur maut ke dar ke maare apne gharon se nikal khade hue the. Allah Taala ne unhe farmaya mar jaao, phir unhe zinda kardiya, beshak Allah Taala logon par bada fazl wala hai, lekin aksar log naashukre hain.
ayahs.244: Allah Taala ki raah mein jihaad karo aur jaan lo ke Allah Taala sunta, jaanta hai.
ayahs.245: Aisa bhi koi hai jo Allah Taala ko achha qarz de pas Allah Taala use bahut badha chadha kar ata farmaaye, Allah hi tangi aur kushaadgi karta hai aur tum sab usi ki taraf lautaaye jaao ge.
ayahs.246: Kya aap ne (Hazrat) Moosa ke baad wali Bani Israeel ki jamaat ko nahi dekha jab ke unhon ne apne paighambar se kaha ke kisi ko hamara baadshah bana dijiye taake hum Allah ki raah mein jihaad karen. Paighambar ne kaha ke mumkin hai jihaad farz hojaane ke baad tum jihaad na karo, unhon ne kaha bhala hum Allah ki raah mein jihaad kyun na karenge? Hum to apne gharon se ujaade gaye hain aur bachchon se door kardiye gaye hain. Phir jab un par jihaad farz hua to siwaaye thode se logon ke sab phir gaye aur Allah Taala zaalimon ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.247: Aur unhe un ke nabi ne farmaya ke Allah Taala ne Taaloot ko tumhara baadshah bana diya hai to kehne lage bhala us ki hum par hukoomat kaise hosakti hai? Us se to bahut ziyaada haqdaar baadshaahat ke hum hain, us ko to maali kushaadgi bhi nahi di gayi. Nabi ne farmaya suno, Allah Taala ne usi ko tum par barguzeeda kiya hai aur use ilmi aur jismaani bartari bhi ata farmaayi hai, baat yeh hai ke Allah jise chaahe apna mulk de, Allah Taala kushaadgi wala aur ilm wala hai.
ayahs.248: Un ke nabi ne unhe phir kaha ke us ki baadshaahat ki zaahiri nishaani yeh hai ke tumhare paas woh sandooq aa jaayega jis mein tumhare Rabb ki taraf se diljam'ee hai aur aal-e-Moosa aur aal-e-Haaroon ka baqiya tarka hai, farishte use utha kar laayenge. Yaqeenan yeh to tumhare liye khuli daleel hai agar tum imaan wale ho.
ayahs.249: Jab (Hazrat) Taaloot lashkaron ko le kar nikle to kaha suno Allah Taala tumhe ek nahr se aazmaane wala hai, jis ne us mein se paani pi liya woh mera nahi aur jo use na chakhe woh mera hai, haan yeh aur baat hai ke apne haath se ek chullu bharle. Lekin siwaaye chand ke baaqi sab ne woh paani pi liya, (Hazrat) Taaloot momineen samet jab nahr se guzar gaye to woh log kehne lage aaj to hum mein taaqat nahi ke Jaaloot aur us ke lashkaron se laden. Lekin Allah Taala ki mulaaqaat par yaqeen rakhne walon ne kaha, basa auqaat chhoti aur thodi si jamaaten badi aur bahut si jamaaton par Allah ke hukm se ghalba paa leti hain, Allah Taala sabr walon ke saath hai.
ayahs.250: Jab un ka Jaaloot aur us ke lashkar se muqaabla hua to unhon ne dua maangi ke aye parwardigaar hamein sabr de, saabit-qadmi de aur qaum-e-kuffaar par hamari madad farma.
ayahs.251: Chunaanche Allah Taala ke hukm se unhon ne Jaalootiyon ko shikast de di aur (Hazrat) Daaood (alaihis salaam) ke haathon Jaaloot qatl hua aur Allah Taala ne Daaood (alaihis salaam) ko mamlakat-o-hikmat aur jitna kuch chaaha ilm bhi ata farmaya. Agar Allah Taala baaz logon ko baaz se dafa na karta to zameen mein fasaad phail jaata, lekin Allah Taala dunya walon par bada fazl-o-karam karne wala hai.
ayahs.252: Yeh Allah Taala ki aayaten hain jinhe hum haqqaaniyat ke saath aap par padhte hain, ba-yaqeen aap Rasoolon mein se hain.
ayahs.253: Yeh Rasool hain jin mein se hum ne baaz ko baaz par fazeelat di hai, un mein se baaz woh hain jin se Allah Taala ne baat cheet ki hai aur baaz ke darje buland kiye hain, aur hum ne Eesa bin Maryam ko mojizaat ata farmaaye aur Rooh-ul-Qudus se un ki taayeed ki. Agar Allah Taala chaahta to un ke baad wale apne paas daleelen aa jaane ke baad hargiz aapas mein ladaayi bhidaayi na karte, lekin un logon ne ikhtilaaf kiya, un mein se baaz to momin hue aur baaz kaafir, aur agar Allah Taala chaahta to yeh aapas mein na ladte, lekin Allah Taala jo chaahta hai karta hai.
ayahs.254: Aye imaan walo! Jo hum ne tumhe de rakha hai us mein se kharch karte raho us se pehle ke woh din aaye jis mein na tijaarat hai na dosti aur shafaa'at aur kaafir hi zaalim hain.
ayahs.255: Allah Taala hi mabood-e-bar-haq hai jis ke siwa koi mabood nahi jo zinda aur sab ka thaamne wala hai, jise na oongh aaye na neend, us ki milkiyat mein zameen aur aasmaanon ki tamaam cheezen hain. Kaun hai jo us ki ijaazat ke baghair us ke saamne shafaa'at karsake, woh jaanta hai jo un ke saamne hai aur jo un ke peechhe hai aur woh us ke ilm mein se kisi cheez ka ihaata nahi karsakte magar jitna woh chaahe, us ki kursi ki wusat ne zameen-o-aasmaan ko gher rakha hai aur Allah Taala un ki hifaazat se na thakta aur na uktaata hai, woh to bahut buland aur bahut bada hai.
ayahs.256: Deen ke baare mein koi zabardasti nahi, hidayat zalaalat se roshan hochuki hai, is liye jo shakhs Allah Taala ke siwa doosre maboodon ka inkaar karke Allah Taala par imaan laaye us ne mazboot kade ko thaam liya, jo kabhi na tootega aur Allah Taala sunne wala, jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.257: Imaan laane walon ka kaarsaaz Allah Taala khud hai, woh unhe andheron se roshni ki taraf nikaal le jaata hai aur kaafiron ke auliya shayaateen hain. Woh unhe roshni se nikaal kar andheron ki taraf le jaate hain, yeh log jahannami hain jo hamesha usi mein pade rahenge.
ayahs.258: Kya tune use nahi dekha jo saltanat paa kar Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) se us ke Rabb ke baare mein jhagad raha tha, jab Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ne kaha ke mera Rabb to woh hai jo jilaata hai aur maarta hai, woh kehne laga main bhi jilaata aur maarta hoon, Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ne kaha Allah Taala sooraj ko mashriq ki taraf se le aata hai to use maghrib ki jaanib se le aa. Ab to woh kaafir bhaunchakka reh gaya, aur Allah Taala zaalimon ko hidayat nahi deta.
ayahs.259: Ya us shakhs ke maanind ke jis ka guzar us basti par hua jo chhat ke bal aundhi padi hui thi, woh kehne laga us ki maut ke baad Allah Taala use kis tarah zinda karega? To Allah Taala ne use maar diya sau saal ke liye, phir use uthaaya, poochha kitni muddat tujh par guzri? Kehne laga ek din ya din ka kuch hissa, farmaya balke tu sau saal tak raha, phir ab tu apne khaane peene ko dekh ke bilkul kharaab nahi hua aur apne gadhe ko bhi dekh, hum tujhe logon ke liye ek nishaani banaate hain tu dekh ke hum haddiyon ko kis tarah uthaate hain, phir un par gosht chadhaate hain, jab yeh sab zaahir ho chuka to kehne laga main jaanta hoon ke Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.260: Aur jab Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ne kaha ke aye mere parwardigaar! Mujhe dikha tu murdon ko kis tarah zinda karega? (Janaab-e-baari ta'ala ne) farmaya, kya tumhe imaan nahi? Jawaab diya imaan to hai lekin mere dil ki taskeen hojaayegi, farmaya chaar parind lo, un ke tukde kar daalo, phir har pahaad par un ka ek ek tukda rakh do phir unhe pukaaro, tumhare paas daudte hue aa jaayenge aur jaan rakho ke Allah Taala ghaalib hai hikmaton wala hai.
ayahs.261: Jo log apna maal Allah Taala ki raah mein kharch karte hain us ki misaal us daane jaisi hai jis mein se saat baaliyaan niklen aur har baali mein sau daane hon, aur Allah Taala jise chaahe badha chadha kar de aur Allah Taala kushaadgi wala aur ilm wala hai.
ayahs.262: Jo log apna maal Allah Taala ki raah mein kharch karte hain phir us ke baad na to ehsaan jataate hain na eeza dete hain, un ka ajr un ke Rabb ke paas hai un par na to kuch khauf hai na woh udaas honge.
ayahs.263: Naram baat kehna aur maaf kardena us sadqe se behtar hai jis ke baad eeza-rasaani ho aur Allah Taala be-niyaaz aur burdbaar hai.
ayahs.264: Aye imaan walo! Apni khairaat ko ehsaan jata kar aur eeza pahuncha kar barbaad na karo! Jis tarah woh shakhs jo apna maal logon ke dikhaawe ke liye kharch kare aur na Allah Taala par imaan rakhe na qayamat par, us ki misaal us saaf patthar ki tarah hai jis par thodi si mitti ho phir us par zordaar meenh barse aur woh use bilkul saaf aur sakht chhod de, un riyaakaaron ko apni kamaayi mein se koi cheez haath nahi lagti aur Allah Taala kaafiron ki qaum ko (seedhi) raah nahi dikhaata.
ayahs.265: Un logon ki misaal jo apna maal Allah Taala ki razaamandi ki talab mein dil ki khushi aur yaqeen ke saath kharch karte hain us baagh jaisi hai jo oonchi zameen par ho aur zordaar baarish us par barse aur woh apna phal dugna laave aur agar us par baarish na bhi barse to phuwaar hi kaafi hai aur Allah tumhare kaam dekh raha hai.
ayahs.266: Kya tum mein se koi bhi yeh chaahta hai ke us ka khajooron aur angooron ka baagh ho, jis mein nahren beh rahi hon aur har qism ke phal maujood hon, us shakhs ka budhaapa aa gaya ho, us ke nanhe nanhe se bachche bhi hon aur achaanak baagh ko bagoola lag jaaye jis mein aag bhi ho, pas woh baagh jal jaaye, isi tarah Allah Taala tumhare liye aayaten bayaan karta hai taake tum ghaur-o-fikr karo.
ayahs.267: Aye imaan walo! Apni paakeeza kamaayi mein se aur zameen mein se tumhare liye hamari nikaali hui cheezon mein se kharch karo, un mein se buri cheezon ke kharch karne ka qasd na karna, jise tum khud lene wale nahi ho, haan agar aankhen band kar lo to, aur jaan lo ke Allah Taala be-parwaah aur khoobiyon wala hai.
ayahs.268: Shaitaan tumhe faqeeri se dhamkaata hai aur be-hayaayi ka hukm deta hai, aur Allah Taala tum se apni bakhshish aur fazl ka waada karta hai, Allah Taala wusat wala aur ilm wala hai.
ayahs.269: Woh jise chaahe hikmat aur daanaayi deta hai aur jo shakhs hikmat aur samajh diya jaaye woh bahut saari bhalaayi diya gaya aur naseehat sirf aqlmand hi haasil karte hain.
ayahs.270: Tum jitna kuch kharch karo yani khairaat aur jo kuch nazr maano use Allah Taala bakhoobi jaanta hai, aur zaalimon ka koi madadgaar nahi.
ayahs.271: Agar tum sadqe khairaat ko zaahir karo to woh bhi achha hai aur agar tum use posheeda posheeda miskeenon ko de do to yeh tumhare haq mein behtar hai, Allah Taala tumhare gunaahon ko mita dega aur Allah Taala tumhare tamaam aamaal ki khabar rakhne wala hai.
ayahs.272: Unhe hidayat par laa khada karna tere zimme nahi balke hidayat Allah Taala deta hai jise chaahta hai aur tum jo bhali cheez Allah ki raah mein do ge us ka faaida khud paao ge. Tumhe sirf Allah Taala ki razaamandi ki talab ke liye hi kharch karna chaahiye, tum jo kuch maal kharch karo ge us ka poora poora badla tumhe diya jaayega, aur tumhara haq na maara jaayega.
ayahs.273: Sadqaat ke mustahiq sirf woh ghuraba hain jo Allah ki raah mein rok diye gaye, jo mulk mein chal phir nahi sakte, naadaan log un ki be-sawaali ki wajah se unhe maaldaar khayaal karte hain, aap un ke chehre dekh kar qiyaafe se unhe pehchaan lenge woh logon se chimat kar sawaal nahi karte, tum jo kuch maal kharch karo to Allah Taala us ka jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.274: Jo log apne maalon ko raat din chhupe khule kharch karte hain un ke liye un ke Rabb ta'ala ke paas ajr hai aur na unhe khauf hai aur na ghamgeeni.
ayahs.275: Sood-khor log na khade honge magar isi tarah jis tarah woh khada hota hai jise shaitaan chhoo kar khabti bana de, yeh is liye ke yeh kaha karte the ke tijaarat bhi to sood hi ki tarah hai, haalaanke Allah Taala ne tijaarat ko halaal kiya aur sood ko haraam, jo shakhs apne paas aayi hui Allah Taala ki naseehat sun kar ruk gaya us ke liye woh hai jo guzra aur us ka maamla Allah Taala ki taraf hai, aur jo phir dobaara (haraam ki taraf) lauta, woh jahannami hai, aise log hamesha hi us mein rahenge.
ayahs.276: Allah Taala sood ko mitaata hai aur sadqa ko badhaata hai aur Allah Taala kisi naashukre aur gunahgaar se muhabbat nahi karta.
ayahs.277: Beshak jo log imaan ke saath (sunnat ke mutaabiq) nek kaam karte hain, namaazon ko qaaim karte hain aur zakaat ada karte hain, un ka ajr un ke Rabb ta'ala ke paas hai, un par na to koi khauf hai, na udaasi aur gham.
ayahs.278: Aye imaan walo! Allah Taala se daro aur jo sood baaqi reh gaya hai woh chhod do, agar tum sach-much imaan wale ho.
ayahs.279: Aur agar aisa nahi karte to Allah Taala se aur us ke Rasool se ladne ke liye taiyaar hojaao, haan agar tauba karlo to tumhara asl maal tumhara hi hai, na tum zulm karo na tum par zulm kiya jaayega.
ayahs.280: Aur agar koi tangi wala ho to use aasaani tak mohlat deni chaahiye aur sadqa karo to tumhare liye bahut hi behtar hai, agar tum mein ilm ho.
ayahs.281: Aur us din se daro jis mein tum sab Allah Taala ki taraf lautaaye jaao ge aur har shakhs ko us ke aamaal ka poora poora badla diya jaayega aur un par zulm nahi kiya jaayega.
ayahs.282: Aye imaan walo! Jab tum aapas mein ek doosre se mee'aad muqarrar par qarz ka maamla karo to use likh liya karo, aur likhne wale ko chaahiye ke tumhara aapas ka maamla adl se likhe, kaatib ko chaahiye ke likhne se inkaar na kare jaise Allah Taala ne use sikhaaya hai, pas use bhi likh dena chaahiye aur jis ke zimme haq ho woh likhwaaye aur apne Allah Taala se dare jo us ka Rabb hai aur haq mein se kuch ghataaye nahi, haan jis shakhs ke zimme haq hai woh agar naadaan ho ya kamzor ho ya likhwaane ki taaqat na rakhta ho to us ka wali adl ke saath likhwa de aur apne mein se do mard gawaah rakh lo, agar do mard na hon to ek mard aur do aurten jinhe tum gawaahon mein se pasand kar lo taake ek ki bhool chook ko doosri yaad dila de aur gawaahon ko chaahiye ke woh jab bulaaye jaayen to inkaar na karen aur qarz ko jis ki muddat muqarrar hai khwaah chhota ho ya bada ho likhne mein kaahili na karo, Allah Taala ke nazdeek yeh baat bahut insaaf wali hai aur gawaahi ko bhi durust rakhne wali aur shak-o-shubha se bhi ziyaada bachaane wali hai, haan yeh aur baat hai ke woh maamla naqd tijaarat ki shakl mein ho jo aapas mein tum len den kar rahe ho to tum par us ke na likhne mein koi gunaah nahi. Khareed-o-farokht ke waqt bhi gawaah muqarrar kar liya karo aur (yaad rakho ke) na to likhne wale ko nuqsaan pahunchaaya jaaye na gawaah ko aur agar tum yeh karo to yeh tumhari khuli naafarmaani hai, Allah Taala se daro, Allah tumhe taaleem de raha hai aur Allah Taala har cheez ko khoob jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.283: Aur agar tum safar mein ho aur likhne wala na paao to rehn qabze mein rakh liya karo, haan agar aapas mein ek doosre se mutmain ho to jise amaanat di gayi hai woh use ada karde aur Allah Taala se darta rahe jo us ka Rabb hai. Aur gawaahi ko na chhupaao aur jo use chhupaale woh gunahgaar dil wala hai aur jo kuch tum karte ho use Allah Taala khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.284: Aasmaanon aur zameen ki har cheez Allah Taala hi ki milkiyat hai. Tumhare dilon mein jo kuch hai use tum zaahir karo ya chhupaao, Allah Taala us ka hisaab tum se lega. Phir jise chaahe bakhshe aur jise chaahe saza de aur Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.285: Rasool imaan laaya us cheez par jo us ki taraf Allah Taala ki jaanib se utri aur momin bhi imaan laaye, yeh sab Allah Taala aur us ke farishton par aur us ki kitaabon par aur us ke Rasoolon par imaan laaye, us ke Rasoolon mein se kisi mein hum tafreeq nahi karte, unhon ne keh diya ke hum ne suna aur itaa'at ki, hum teri bakhshish talab karte hain aye hamare Rabb! Aur hamein teri hi taraf lautna hai.
ayahs.286: Allah Taala kisi jaan ko us ki taaqat se ziyaada takleef nahi deta, jo neki woh kare woh us ke liye aur jo buraayi woh kare woh us par hai, aye hamare Rabb! Agar hum bhool gaye hon ya khata ki ho to hamein na pakadna, aye hamare Rabb! Hum par woh bojh na daal jo hum se pehle logon par daala tha, aye hamare Rabb! Hum par woh bojh na daal jis ki hamein taaqat na ho aur hum se darguzar farma! Aur hamein bakhsh de aur hum par reham kar! Tu hi hamara maalik hai, hamein kaafiron ki qaum par ghalba ata farma.
